gib_castle_guide.text: The Moors held Gibraltar from 711 until 1309, then again from 1333 until 1462. The Tower of Homage goes back to the second period. The scars on the wall are from the Great Siege.
The tower stands where the Moorish fortress stood. The Tower, The Gatehouse and the Keep. It's a beautiful view over the Bay and the whole town. And a very long staircase.
